notes_for_editor: Thin record: two 1937-38 Ukiah newspaper items, one Peakbagging photo page and two listing pages. firelookout.org row for Poison Rock: type Encl. Tower, status Gone, no register number. The NHLR US 1368, CA 191 first drafted here belongs to Plummer Peak (Trinity County) and was removed. The kind correction to tower was withdrawn because firelookout.org lists Encl. Tower. Access and ownership unverified; no visit facts recorded.
